title: Site settings
lead: Typed settings: each key has a default, a kind and a description. Secrets are sealed and never shown again.
infoCard: Values are checked when saved. An error shows right under the wrong block; nothing is saved part-way through a key. Only people with the “Change settings” permission see this page.

site.title: Time zone
site.help: “Today” in the statistics starts at midnight in this time zone.

contest.title: Official contests
contest.help: Official contest mode: people who are not superusers cannot edit introductions or names, read or write comments, vote or post on the blog.

mail.title: Email
mail.help: The sender address and the SMTP server. An empty SMTP URL means email is not configured.

google.title: Sign in with Google
google.help: Turns on social sign-in: both a client id and a client secret are needed.

github.title: Sign in with GitHub
github.help: Turns on social sign-in: both a client id and a client secret are needed.

facebook.title: Sign in with Facebook
facebook.help: Turns on social sign-in: both a client id and a client secret are needed.

pwned.title: Leaked password check
pwned.help: The Have I Been Pwned range API address. Leave empty to turn the check off.

discord.title: Discord webhooks
discord.help: The whole list is a secret: written, never read back. Saving replaces the whole list.

pdf.title: PDF export
pdf.help: The time and size limits of each problem statement PDF render.

similarity.title: Similarity detection
similarity.help: Each run keeps the pairs above these thresholds; it compares at most the newest submissions per problem and language family.

contest.banAfterDisqualifications: An integer from 0 to 1000; 0 turns it off. Counts only contests that are not organization-only.

mail.from: An address or “Name <address>”, on one line.
mail.smtpUrl: smtp:// or smtps://, credentials percent-encoded. Never shown again.

auth.pwnedApiUrl: Empty or https. The live server does not accept internal addresses.

secret.emptyKeeps: An empty box on save keeps the stored secret. To remove it, use “Clear secret”, not an empty box.

oauth.needsClientId: A client id is needed while enabled.
oauth.secretHint: The value is encrypted on save and never shown again. Leave empty to keep it.

webhooks.title: Webhook list
webhooks.note: Up to 20 addresses, https only. An empty list turns notifications off.

errors.integer: Must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.

revisions.title: History · {key}
revisions.subtitle: Newest first · 20 per page
revisions.footnote: A restore is written as a new revision in the history.
revisions.secretNote: A secret shows only “set” or “not set”, never a value.
revisions.notRestorable: A secret value cannot be restored.
revisions.confirmBody: The server sets the old value back and writes it as a new revision; the stored secret is kept.
